name: Inazuma Boin
original_name: 異妻母淫－いなづまぼいん－
source: While spying on a busty housewife our protagonist catches her in an act of adultery. Deciding he can't let this opportunity go to waste he blackmails her and tells her to meet him in the park restroom.
translation: 在监视一位丰满的家庭主妇时，我们的主角发现她正在通奸。他决定不能浪费这个机会，于是勒索了她，并让她在公园洗手间与他见面。
